specs.theme: Machiavelli on whether a ruler should be loved or feared

sources.context: Niccolo Machiavelli was a Florentine writer and former government official; he wrote this treatise on rulers in 1513, and it was first printed in 1532.

specs.theme: A printed world map of 1507 that shows Ptolemy, Vespucci and the lands across the Atlantic

sources.context: This world map was printed in 1507 in Saint-Die, in Lorraine, by the mapmaker Martin Waldseemuller; the only known surviving copy is in the Library of Congress.

specs.theme: Hobbes and Locke on the state of nature

sources.context: Thomas Hobbes was an English philosopher; he published this book in 1651, a few years after the English Civil War.
John Locke was an English philosopher; he published this book in 1689-1690, soon after the Glorious Revolution.
